```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 10

library(terra)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)




CRW_DHW_2011 <- rast("~/abrolhos/data/CRW_DHW_2011.tif") |> max()
CRW_DHW_2025 <- rast("~/abrolhos/data/CRW_DHW_2025.tif") |> max()
CRW_DHW <- c(CRW_DHW_2011, CRW_DHW_2025)
names(CRW_DHW) <- c("max NOAA_DHW\n 2011", "max NOAA_DHW \n 2025")
units(CRW_DHW) <- c("max DHW", "max DHW")
CRW_DHW_delta <- CRW_DHW_2025-CRW_DHW_2011
names(CRW_DHW_delta) <- "Δ NOAA_DHW \n2025-2011"
WAcoastline <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(country="Australia", scale="large") |> vect() |> crop(CRW_DHW_delta)
abrovect_ext <- ext(c(113.4, 114.2, -29.2, -28.1))
abrovect <- vect("/Users/rof011/abrolhos/allen/Abrolhos-20260529190655/Geomorphic-Map/geomorphic.geojson")
abrovect_poly <- as.polygons(abrovect_ext, crs = "EPSG:4326")



a <- ggplot() + theme_bw() +
  tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data=CRW_DHW, show.legend=TRUE) + 
  tidyterra::geom_spatvector(data=WAcoastline) +
  tidyterra::geom_spatvector(data=abrovect_poly, linewidth=0.3, color="darkred", fill=NA) +
  facet_wrap(~lyr) +
  #scale_fill_distiller(palette="OrRd", name = "maxDHW", direction=1, limits=c(0,42))# +
  cmocean::scale_fill_cmocean(name = "thermal", scale_name="maxDHW", limits=c(0,42)) +
  labs(fill = "maxDHW")


b <- ggplot() + theme_bw() +
  facet_wrap(~lyr) +
  tidyterra::geom_spatraster(data=CRW_DHW_delta) + 
  tidyterra::geom_spatvector(data=WAcoastline) +
  tidyterra::geom_spatvector(data=abrovect_poly, linewidth=0.3, color="darkred", fill=NA) +
  #scale_fill_distiller(palette="RdBu", name = "Δ maxDHW", limits=c(-25,25))# +
  cmocean::scale_fill_cmocean(name = "balance", limits=c(-25, 25)) +
  labs(fill = "Δ maxDHW")

#   cmocean::scale_fill_cmocean(name = "thermal", limits=c(0,42))

regionalplot <- wrap_plots(
  a + theme(legend.position = "left"),
  b + theme(legend.position = "right"),
  ncol = 2,
  widths = c(1, 0.55)
)

regionalplot
```
